market_summary: Markets rebounded on Wed 25 Nov after Monday's fall: the Nifty rose 1.85% to 25,819.25 and the Sensex 1.82% to 83,938, led by FMCG (+3.8%, HUL +6%), financials (+2.2%) and banks (about +1.8-2%), while metals fell 2.1% as Tata Steel kept sliding on the APL Apollo deal; midcaps were flat and smallcaps slightly lower. FIIs bought a provisional ₹4,479 cr (11th straight buying day) and DIIs also bought ₹4,019 cr; India VIX fell about 7% to near 16.4. GIFT Nifty was near 26,020 early today, pointing to another gap-up, but Brent is back near $95 after Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia and US markets are shut for Thanksgiving. Results season is over and no notable results are due today; RBI policy is on 4 Dec.

buy_ideas.name: Apollo Hospitals
buy_ideas.target_source: Macquarie (double upgrade to Outperform from Underperform, target raised from ₹6,230), via INDmoney 20 Nov
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 23% to ₹7,615 cr, EBITDA 29% to ₹1,191 cr and profit 32% to ₹630 cr; margin widened to 15.6% from 14.9%. Inpatient volumes +14%, occupancy up to 73%, pharmacy (HealthCo) EBITDA +75%. Stock jumped 5.3% to an all-time high of about ₹9,200 on 20 Nov; Macquarie's ₹10,500 target is about 14% higher, and Motilal had ₹10,400.
buy_ideas.risks: Bought after a 5% one-day jump to a record high, so wait for a dip rather than chasing. Hospital stocks sold off earlier this month on fears of drug-price regulation (Supreme Court query on pharmacy markups); that risk has not gone away. The price shown predates the 23 Nov fall (Nifty -1.75%) and the 25 Nov rebound (+1.85%), so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: Eicher Motors
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 20% and profit about 15%. Stock closed ₹8,056 (+4.6%) on 19 Nov as autos rallied 4.4% on cheaper copper and aluminium, which eases the margin worry. Emkay's ₹9,100 target is about 13% above the close.
buy_ideas.risks: EBITDA margin fell 80 bps to 23.7%, and the stock has already jumped in one day; Motilal Oswal is only Neutral at ₹7,420. Metal prices can bounce back. No fresh price found for 20 Nov; ₹8,056 is the 19 Nov close (autos rose about 0.5% on Friday). The price shown predates the 23 Nov fall (Nifty -1.75%) and the 25 Nov rebound (+1.85%), so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: Laurus Labs
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up about 33% to ₹2,206 cr, led by CDMO up about 86%; EBITDA ₹750 cr at a 34% margin (up 962 bps) and profit ₹437 cr. Still the cleanest earnings beat on the list; pharma rose 0.6% on 19 Nov.
buy_ideas.risks: Upside to target only about 9%. CDMO orders are lumpy. No fresh price found; ₹2,338 is the broker's reference price, so check the live quote. The price shown predates the 23 Nov fall (Nifty -1.75%) and the 25 Nov rebound (+1.85%), so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: Hitachi Energy India
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 64% and profit up 21%; new orders up 86%, taking the order book to ₹33,300 cr. IDBI sees revenue up 57% in FY27 and margins rising to 16.7% by FY28; target about 25% above the reference price.
buy_ideas.risks: Price is implied from the 17 Nov note (no fresh quote found), so check it. Very expensive stock, and profit grew much slower than revenue. The price shown predates the 23 Nov fall (Nifty -1.75%) and the 25 Nov rebound (+1.85%), so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: ABB India
buy_ideas.thesis: September-quarter revenue up 12% and profit up 8%, with a record order book up 36% to about ₹12,900 cr. Two brokers say Buy, targets about 18-20% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: Margin fell 70 bps and profit growth was modest; valued at about 60 times 2028 earnings. No fresh price found; ₹6,923 is from the earlier broker notes. The price shown predates the 23 Nov fall (Nifty -1.75%) and the 25 Nov rebound (+1.85%), so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: PTC Industries
buy_ideas.target_source: ICICI Securities (Buy, reiterated), via Trendlyne 24 Nov
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 72.7% and net profit 83.5% year on year, helped by aerospace contract wins from Safran and Airbus. ICICI Securities projects 70% revenue and 91% profit growth a year through FY29; its ₹29,000 target is 18.7% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: Price is implied from the 18.7% upside (Trendlyne gave no quote), so check the live price. Very expensive, small-float stock that can swing hard; the growth depends on aerospace orders ramping up on time. Smallcaps lagged the 25 Nov rebound (Smallcap 100 about -0.5%).

avoid.reason: Down about 29% from its pre-deal close to Wednesday's low after agreeing to buy Tata Steel's tubes and colour-coated businesses for about ₹28,000 cr, debt-funded, with Tata Steel then taking control via a promoter stake buy and open offer (about ₹32,267 cr). Debt rises sharply; group stocks SG Finserve and SG Mart also crashed. Deal news, not earnings; let the price settle.

Fell another 2.3% to ₹159.30 on 25 Nov, about 10.5% down in two sessions, on worries over the APL Apollo deal's valuation and debt funding (consolidated gross debt already ₹1.02 trn). Not an earnings move; wait for clarity.

Management news, not earnings: the bank terminated former MD and CEO Sumant Kathpalia and will reclaim his pay since 2020; the stock bounced about 10% from the day's low on 20 Nov to above ₹1,000. Don't chase a news spike.
USFDA warning letter for its Daman plant, which brings in about 9% of revenue. US approvals from that site can stall; wait for the remediation plan.
Fell about 6% on 19 Nov after co-founder Alok Bansal said he is leaving his executive role, then jumped 7.6% to about ₹1,100 on 23 Nov. Management-news swings, not earnings; don't chase.

Results missed: Q2 revenue up only 4.1% and profit down 18.5% on raw-material costs; IDBI cut FY27-28 profit estimates by about 17%. IDBI still says Buy at ₹5,271 (30% upside, implying about ₹4,050) after a 21% fall in three months, but wait for margins to recover.

ICICI Direct says Sell with a ₹490 target (about 10% below ₹544) as margins shrank sharply despite strong revenue.
Results missed: Q2 loss of about ₹5,531 cr after one-off charges and JLR cut its margin guidance to 2-3%. Bounced 3.7% on 19 Nov with the auto rally, but that is a sector move, not a fix.
Results missed: Q2 profit fell about 62%. ICICI Direct says only Hold at ₹3,100 (about 8% above ₹2,858).

Q2 profit up 82% is flattered by a one-time gain from selling a subsidiary stake to KATO Works; underlying revenue grew 20.5%. ICICI Direct's ₹1,515 Buy stands, but don't treat the profit jump as an earnings beat.
